notes: Read-only Python pipeline. D2 re-uses R4C's corrected fee matrix and R4's per-event swap data (both already on disk).
D2 does NOT re-pull on-chain data. D2 does NOT touch wallets, signers, broadcasters, MEV submitters, or store adapters.
D2 does NOT use any CEX/perp API key. Only public, no-auth Binance endpoint was queried.
D2 does NOT place any orders. The hedge is a theoretical model assumption, not a real trade.
Funding history was pulled at the 15m checkpoint and saved to funding_history.csv. The dynamic-delta replay reads it as a static input.
No chain state mutations: this stage produced CSVs/JSONL/MD only.
No LP, swap, approve, collect, mint, addLiquidity, removeLiquidity, bridge, or signing call was attempted.
Freeze preserved: no canary, no live, no paper, no mode B, no R1/R2/R3/R4 long-horizon collector restart, no wallet instantiation.
Per user policy: no auto-exit engineering was written; no tiny live probe was started; no live/canary/paper.

D1's NEED_MORE_DATA was upgraded to GO_DELTA_HEDGED_LP_PLAN_ONLY based on: (1) real 89.3d funding history showing NEUTRAL regime, (2) dynamic-delta replay with rebalance rules finding 16 robust cells positive under both median and p5 stress funding, (3) signal/noise 1.5-3.2 at best cells.
The GO is plan-only. No execution. D3 (reward APR) is the next stage and requires explicit user authorization.
